messages:
maria: Heads up — after v1.9 canary -> 100% we started seeing a spike in toolcall failures for function_router. Errors show 'no_tool_selected' and empty tool arrays. Customer P-314 hitting 500s.
devin: ack. any latency or token-rate changes visible?
maria: latency is stable, token throughput normal. error rate for /v1/funcall jumped ~0.2% -> ~6% around 2026-03-15 08:12 UTC. Sample log below.
maria: ```json
{"request_id":"req_7a2b","model":"redwood-1.9","decision":"none","tools":[]}
```
sam: repro'd locally. When prompt includes explicit tool hint like "@calendar create_event" model returns empty selection. Looks like tool tokens get stripped in decoding path.
sam: Repro steps (quick):
1) curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer $KEY' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"model":"redwood-1.9","input":"Call calendar.create_event with title X","tools":["calendar"]}'
2) Response: {"tools":[]}

julie: Noted. v1.9 included a tokenization/decoding tweak we pushed last week. Can we confirm it's model-side not runtime routing? oncall-ml?
oncall-ml: Confirmed. Reproduced against the raw model binary: beam search appears to stop before emitting tool-choice sentinel when remainder length < threshold — effectively skipping tool output. Patching decoding to always allow sentinel emission fixed the repro locally.
oncall-ml: Quick mitigation: recommend rollback to v1.8 in impacted regions or enable decode_force_tool_sentinel flag while we validate a proper fix.
maria: Customers impacted already. I'd push rollback for eu-west-1 first. Any AB toggle to force old behavior?
deploy-bot: rollback started for region eu-west-1 by @julie (deploy id dpl_992). ETA ~8m :hourglass_flowing_sand:
devin: After rollback, we should verify queues/backpressure for retries and check billing spikes. Julie — can you open a follow-up with failing prompts so support can notify P-314?
julie: opened PM-882. Added failing prompt set, model hash for v1.9, and a minimal unit test. Also adding regression test to CI to run function-choice prompts against future model updates.
maria: Thanks. Support team will notify P-314 and track for confirmation once eu-west rollback completes. :phone:
julie: I'll keep this thread updated with canary results once we re-run a limited patch canary with the forced-sentinel flag
